answer: Rotating Witness Lottery. Each epoch, a beacon derived from a public randomness source (e.g., a comet-tracking observatory feed) assigns agents to verification committees; assignment is unknown until the dawn of that epoch, so attackers cannot precompute which identities must collude. New identities must first survive one randomly-timed juniper challenge round, where a live committee audits their work. Each Sybil identity therefore pays the full compute and latency cost of an unpredictable audit it cannot schedule around, and repeated failed audits forfeit its registration.
